title: Assemble the one-tick backend-neutral schedule
requires: A physical supported GPU, shared Slang build toolchain and public-API test harness
scope: Assemble and enforce the new profile's single advance with one shared spatial publication, bounded domain/coupling solves and final state commit. Follow docs/roadmap/F8-REALTIME-60HZ.md; preserve legacy-profile evidence and do not expand advertised interaction modes.
acceptance: Tests assert exactly one time advance, at most one dynamic index update and no per-domain/per-edge time subdivision for empty, single-domain and mixed scenes.
Remove routine between-phase host waits/readbacks; retain producer/consumer GPU hazards and explicit application synchronization with validation evidence.
Enforce per-domain iteration and dispatch/work budgets, GPU-resident active counts and allocation-free steady state; expose input/render snapshot ownership safely.
Run all new-profile independent integration cases at dt=1/60; report simulation rate without using slow-motion to pass a frame-time gate.

history.reason: Added allocation-free backend-neutral tick assembly with exact clock, spatial, domain, coupling, commit and snapshot ownership; host and Pixel 7 integration cases plus provenance-bound Vulkan regression passed.
